1 (Currently Amended): A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus __of greater than 10MPa and less than or equal to 100MPa__.

2 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone.

3 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in claim 1 or 2, wherein the membrane (10) is injection moulded.

5 (Currently Amended): A speaker as claimed in any preceding claim, wherein the membrane (10) comprises a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the speaker further comprises a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane (10) to the coil (8), __wherein the stiffening element has a Young's modulus greater than 100MPa__. 

10 (Currently Amended): A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus __of greater than 10MPa and less than or equal to 100MPa__; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).

11 (Currently Amended): A method as claimed in claim 10, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises silicone.

13 (Currently Amended): A method as claimed in claim 10, 11 or 12, wherein the membrane (10) is formed using injection moulding.

14 (Currently Amended): A method as claimed in any one of claims 10 to 13, wherein the membrane (10) is formed with a flat central region and a supporting edge region, and wherein the method further comprises providing a stiffening element (16) on the flat central region on the opposite side of the membrane to the coil (8), __wherein the stiffening element has a Young's modulus greater than 100MPa__.
